forecasts.evaluation_note: Retrospective nested rolling-origin replay: every target was hidden from its fit and method selection. This development rerun is not independent prospective validation.
forecasts.error_sign_note: Error = forecast minus actual; positive mean error indicates overprediction.
forecasts.metric_note: MAE/RMSE are in the series unit. WAPE is total absolute error divided by total heldout actual volume; it is unavailable if every heldout actual is zero and is not an accuracy probability.
forecasts.baseline_comparison_note: Fixed methods and guarded policy are scored on identical outer fiscal years. Retrospective benchmark rankings do not select the production method.

method_notes.mean3: Mean of the last three annual observations.
method_notes.damped_trend: Custom conservative trend: last value plus half the ordinary-least-squares slope over at most five annual observations; clipped at zero. This is not fitted Holt damped exponential smoothing.
